prompt_variants.name: adversarial-length-locked
prompt_variants.rationale: Strict length and register parity plus explicit ban on negation/antonym shortcuts.

prompt_variants.name: adversarial-hard-negative
prompt_variants.rationale: Forces generation of semantically close distractors rather than obvious reversals or unrelated idioms.

prompt_variants.name: taxonomy-guided
prompt_variants.rationale: Haladyna / VERGE taxonomy with tightened surface constraints to prevent label echo and antonym traps.

prompt_variants.name: overgenerate-select
prompt_variants.rationale: Overgenerate-then-select with adversarial filtering and length/register locks.
